notes: Prices in USD per 1M tokens, standard (non-batch) API tier. Tiered-price models record the base (lowest) tier with the higher tier in the model's note field. Retired models excluded; deprecated-but-available models included. Collected Monday 2026-09-28, 7 days after the previous file. Tracked scope follows the set established on 2026-07-16 so week-over-week deltas stay meaningful. All 47 rows carried from 2026-09-21 are unchanged on input, output and cache-read price, across all six providers: a fifth consecutive week with no price change on the carried set. Every change this week is an arrival. Four models entered and none left, taking the set from 47 rows to 51. Anthropic added claude-opus-5-5 at $4/$20, 20% below the $5/$25 of Claude Opus 5 on both input and output. The models overview now names it the default starting model, and Opus 5 moves to the page's additional-models list. Its cache hits are priced at 0.05x base input ($0.20/MTok). That makes a third Claude cache-read multiplier, beside the 0.1x standard and the 0.025x of Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. Its absolute cache-read price matches Claude Sonnet 5's $0.20. As a 4.7-and-later model it falls under the newer tokenizer statement, bringing the affected rows to nine. OpenAI added gpt-6-sol at $2.00/$10.00 and gpt-6-luna at $0.10/$0.50, completing the GPT-6 line beside gpt-6-astra. gpt-6-sol costs half of gpt-5.6-sol's promotional $4.00/$20.00 and matches Claude Sonnet 5's $2/$10. gpt-6-luna costs half of gpt-5.6-luna on input ($0.20 to $0.10) and 58% less on output ($1.20 to $0.50), and is now the cheapest OpenAI row in the set. xAI added grok-4.7 at $2.00/$6.00 with cache read $0.50 and a 500K context, identical to grok-4.6 at both tiers. The xAI models page now shows only grok-4.7, so this week's xAI rows were read from xAI's pricing page (docs.x.ai/developers/pricing), and the xAI source_url changes accordingly. The rates on that page for the six carried xAI rows match 2026-09-21. Two statements carried in earlier files are no longer on the pages. Anthropic's pricing page no longer states that the Claude Sonnet 5 $2/$10 rate 'is now the standard price' or that the cancelled increase will not occur; the row still reads $2/$10 with no scheduled change. DeepSeek's page no longer carries the statement that deepseek-v4-pro service continues after 2026-09-14; the model is still listed at unchanged rates. Both removals are recorded as observations, not as changes in price. Newly recorded and outside the rows: Google lists gemini-omni-1.1-flash (Gemini Omni Flash) and gemini-omni-flash-preview at $1.50 input and $9.00 text output ($17.50 video output) with no context-caching price. This series has not recorded them before; the page carries no dates, so whether they are new this week is unknown. Whether a multimodal-output model belongs in a text-model series is a scope question for 기웅. Mistral lists OCR 4.1 as new; as an OCR model priced per page it is outside scope. Anthropic's pricing table still shows rows for Claude Opus 4.1, Opus 4, Sonnet 4 and Haiku 3.5, which its deprecations page marks as retired from the first-party API. They stay excluded under the retired-models rule. Still observed and still out of the rows, unchanged from 2026-09-21: the OpenAI cyber line (gpt-5.6-cyber and gpt-5.5-cyber at $12.50/$75.00, cached input $1.25) and the gpt-daybreak aliases; Mistral's third-party GLM 5.3 and GLM 5.2 at $1.40/$4.40 (the resale scope question for 기웅 remains open); Ministral 3 in three sizes; OpenAI gpt-5.2 and earlier; and Google's image, embedding, TTS, video, live and transcription models. Carried statements unchanged this week: the Anthropic tokenizer note (Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview produce approximately 30% more tokens for the same text); DeepSeek still accepts the legacy ids deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp and serves them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at Flash pricing; the gpt-5.6-sol promotional rate still runs at least through 2026-11-21; and the three Gemini Flash rows at $0.75/$3.75 still double on 2027-01-01.
